reasons: The candidate multiplies the result by 100, a numeric constant not present in the Datadog source; the rules forbid applying it in promql, and it changes the unit and quantity.

Datadog system.net.bytes_rcvd is already a bytes-per-second series, and system.network.io (monotonic sum, unit By) with rate() over the receive direction yields the same bytes/s quantity, so an exact translation without the factor exists.

The selector, sum aggregation over all series (scope template variable dropped), and the direction matcher using the observed label system_network_direction are otherwise consistent with the definitions and dataset labels.
Outcome translated is correct because a direct OTel equivalent exists; the fix is to remove the * 100 factor.
